key_insight: The paper combines semi-smooth Newton solving, POD-based reduction, and neural-network corrections to build a faster reduced-order solver for nonlinear parametric variational inequalities.
engineering_relevance: This enables efficient simulation of challenging mechanics problems such as obstacle contact and frictional contact while retaining accuracy and lowering online computational cost.
method: Mixed primal-dual formulation with projection-based complementarity conditions solved by semi-smooth Newton iterations.
POD reduction of both primal and dual snapshot spaces, then a neural network learns corrections in truncated coordinates to form a nonlinear manifold.
Sparse cubature hyper-reduction with greedy nonnegative least squares accelerates residual evaluation in the online phase.
evidence_signal: The framework is tested on a 2D obstacle problem and a 3D frictional contact problem, with comparisons against full-order, linear reduced, neural-augmented reduced, and hyper-reduced models showing accurate approximations and substantial speedups.
watch_item: Performance depends on how well the learned manifold and hyper-reduction remain compatible; inaccurate training snapshots or cubature selection could degrade robustness.
paper_title: A Hyper-Reduced Neural Network-Augmented Semi-smooth Newton Method for Nonlinear Parametric Variational Inequalities
